hypotheses.title_zh: 带阻尼的趋势项
hypotheses.statement_en: Holt damped-trend smoothing (level plus damped trend of the shares) gives a better list than the decayed sum.
hypotheses.statement_zh: Holt 阻尼趋势平滑（份额的水平加上带阻尼的趋势）给出的榜单比衰减累加更好。

prediction.text: No gain: |mean diff| <= 0.005 for the damped primary at n=100; undamped (p=1.0) loses at least 0.02.

hypotheses.anchor: Gardner 2006: damped trend hard to beat on average, but a trend term is a smoothed difference of noisy levels (variance); local drift slope median 0.72 and H2 (rising items) lost 0.039

hypotheses.title_zh: 截断单轮尖峰
hypotheses.statement_en: Clipping each item's count in a round at 3 rows before sharing gives a better list.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 把每轮中每个物品的计数截断在 3 条再计算份额，榜单更好。

prediction.text: No difference: |mean diff| < 0.003.

hypotheses.anchor: Gardner 2006 s4.1 (trimmed smoothing helped on daily supermarket series); our caps of 30 rows lost 0.0006, so little heavy-tail damage is left

hypotheses.title_zh: 倒数排名聚合
hypotheses.statement_en: Adding per-round reciprocal-rank scores 1/(60+rank), decayed with half-life 2, gives a better list than adding shares.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 把每轮的倒数排名分数 1/(60+排名) 按半衰期 2 累加，比累加份额得到更好的榜单。

prediction.text: Gain: mean diff >= +0.01 at n=100 (set after a one-log smoke test showed +0.043; see disclosure).

hypotheses.anchor: Cormack et al. 2009 RRF k=60 beat score fusion by 4-5% MAP in retrieval; Renda and Straccia 2003 found score sums beat Borda in metasearch

hypotheses.title_zh: 对新物品更快遗忘
hypotheses.statement_en: Items first seen less than 4 rounds ago use half-life 1, older items half-life 4; this beats one half-life for everything.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 首次出现不到 4 轮的物品用半衰期 1，更老的物品用半衰期 4，比所有物品用同一半衰期更好。

prediction.text: No gain (likely a loss): mean diff <= +0.005.

hypotheses.anchor: [INFERENCE] earlier tournament killed every re-weighting of the baseline; item-age mixing splices two score scales

hypotheses.title_en: Shrink each round toward the tracker
hypotheses.title_zh: 每轮份额向已有榜单收缩
hypotheses.statement_en: Shrinking each round's shares toward the tracker's own shares (empirical-Bayes style, weight 0.5) gives a better list.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 把每轮份额向追踪器自身的份额收缩（经验贝叶斯式，权重 0.5），榜单更好。

prediction.text: No gain at 30 rounds: mean diff <= +0.005 (Clevenson-Zidek shrinkage cannot change a ranking when all items have equal exposure).

hypotheses.anchor: Efron and Morris / Clevenson-Zidek: shrinkage of Poisson counts with equal exposure is a rank-preserving rescaling; here the prior is the tracker so it acts as extra smoothing

hypotheses.title_en: Forget faster when the list jumps
hypotheses.title_zh: 榜单跳变时加快遗忘
hypotheses.statement_en: When a round's shares differ from the tracker by more than 1.5 times the usual change, halving the tracker's memory gives a better list.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 当某一轮份额与追踪器的差异超过平常变化的 1.5 倍时，把追踪器的记忆减半，榜单更好。

prediction.text: No gain: mean diff <= +0.005 (the detector rarely fires under slow drift).

hypotheses.anchor: ADWIN (Bifet and Gavalda 2007); Gama et al. 2014 survey: detectors pay off under abrupt change, our measured drift slope is 0.2-1.26 (gradual)

hypotheses.title_zh: 多个半衰期的集成
hypotheses.statement_en: Adding the normalised decayed lists with half-lives 1, 2 and 4 gives a better list than half-life 2 alone.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 把半衰期 1、2、4 的归一化衰减榜单相加，比只用半衰期 2 更好。

prediction.text: No gain on Amazon logs (mean diff <= +0.005); a gain of at least +0.005 on the non-Amazon logs where the best half-life is not 2.

hypotheses.anchor: Brown 2008 / forecast-combination literature: combining smoothers helps mainly when the best parameter is unknown

hypotheses.title_zh: 让榜单保持稳定
hypotheses.statement_en: Giving items on the previous list a 10% score bonus cuts list churn by at least 30% at a cost of less than 0.005 NDCG.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 给上一期榜单上的物品加 10% 的分数加成，使榜单变动至少减少 30%，而 NDCG 损失小于 0.005。

prediction.text: Churn falls by >= 30% (relative) and NDCG diff >= -0.005.

hypotheses.anchor: Hysteresis / stability regularisation in top-k maintenance; exact null on NDCG alone is expected

hypotheses.title_zh: 为上升物品预留名额
hypotheses.statement_en: Replacing the last 10 list slots by the items whose recent share (half-life 1) most exceeds their older share (half-life 4) gives a better list.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 把榜单最后 10 个名额换成近期份额（半衰期 1）最超出旧份额（半衰期 4）的物品，榜单更好。

prediction.text: No gain: mean diff <= +0.005 (reserved slots cost ranks 91-100 more than rising items earn).

hypotheses.anchor: Bandit-style exploration slots; tournament round 1 (H2) found extra weight for rising items cost 0.039

hypotheses.title_zh: 去年同一季节
hypotheses.statement_en: At 60 and 90 rounds (rounds of 3-4.5 months) adding the shares of the same season one year earlier (weight 0.5) gives a better list.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 在 60 轮和 90 轮（每轮 3 到 4.5 个月）下，加入一年前同一季节的份额（权重 0.5），榜单更好。

prediction.text: Gain at 90 rounds: mean diff >= +0.01 on Amazon logs; no gain on non-Amazon logs. (Earlier year-ago-list test: year-ago list alone was worse in 16 of 16 categories; here it is only an added term.)

hypotheses.anchor: Seasonal naive / Holt-Winters; our S1 test (year-ago list alone, 0 of 16 better); Amazon December peaks

hypotheses.title_zh: 轮换小组
hypotheses.statement_en: Keeping 75% of last round's reporters (rotation rate 0.25) gives a better list than asking fresh people every round.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 保留上一轮 75% 的汇报者（轮换率 0.25），比每轮都问新的人榜单更好。

prediction.text: No gain, and a loss that grows with overlap: rho=0.25 diff <= 0.0; rho=0.1 worse than rho=0.25 in at least 60% of logs.

hypotheses.anchor: Cantwell 2008, Kish 1999: gain depends on within-unit correlation rho (about 0 for item-level popularity on review logs); plain decayed sum: fresh wins when drift is slow

hypotheses.title_en: Ask people in proportion to activity
hypotheses.title_zh: 按活跃度比例抽人
hypotheses.statement_en: Drawing the n reporters with probability proportional to their rows in the round gives a better list than drawing them uniformly.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 按本轮行数成比例地抽 n 个汇报者，比均匀抽样榜单更好。

prediction.text: Gain: mean diff >= +0.01 at n=100 (set after a one-log smoke showed +0.048; note the pooled row count is size-biased).

hypotheses.anchor: Hansen-Hurwitz / Horvitz-Thompson: with p proportional to size and an uncorrected pooled count the estimate is size-biased, but the target (row counts) is itself dominated by heavy users

hypotheses.title_zh: 按轮的样本量加权
hypotheses.statement_en: When the number of reporters varies from round to round, weighting each round by its number of reporters beats weighting rounds equally.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 当各轮汇报者人数不同时，按人数给各轮加权，比等权更好。

prediction.text: Gain: mean diff >= +0.01 against equal weighting under the same variable round sizes (set after a one-log smoke showed +0.033).

hypotheses.anchor: Inverse-variance weighting (standard); variance of a round's share vector is proportional to 1/n_w

hypotheses.title_en: Do samples add to a periodic census
hypotheses.title_zh: 样本能给定期普查再加分吗
hypotheses.statement_en: If a full count is available every 4 rounds, adding the continuous n=100 samples (weight 2 on the census) to the census beats using the census alone.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 如果每 4 轮有一次全量统计，再加上每轮 n=100 的样本（普查权重 2），比只用普查更好。

prediction.text: No gain at n=100 (mean diff <= +0.005 against the stale census list); a gain at n=1000 would be reported as exploratory.

hypotheses.anchor: Composite / benchmark estimators need the sample to carry information the benchmark lacks; at n=100 a 4-round-old full count already beats the sample (eq. age 4.4 rounds)

hypotheses.title_zh: 样本追平定期普查所需的人数
hypotheses.statement_en: The number of people per round at which the sampled tracker matches a full count taken every 4 or 8 rounds.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 样本追踪器追平每 4 轮或 8 轮一次全量统计所需的每轮人数。

prediction.text: Break-even n (first n on the grid with NDCG(sampled) >= NDCG(censold m=4)) is above 300 in at least 70% of eligible logs.

hypotheses.anchor: [INFERENCE] equivalent age 4.4 rounds at n=100 (tracking study)
hypotheses.analysis: For each log and m in {4,8}: NDCG@100 (steady steps >= 8, mean over draws) of baseline at each n vs NDCG of censold:m; break-even = smallest n on the grid {10,30,100,300,1000,3000} with sampled >= census; censored if never. Report share of logs with break-even > 300 (censored counts as > 300) and the median.

hypotheses.title_zh: 中心化差分隐私的代价表
hypotheses.statement_en: How many people per round are needed for central differential privacy (each person limited to 10 rows) to cost less than 0.05 NDCG.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 中心化差分隐私（每人最多 10 条）要使 NDCG 损失小于 0.05，每轮需要多少人。

prediction.text: At n=10000, eps=2 loses < 0.05 in at least 50% of eligible logs; at n=1000, eps=8 does NOT reach < 0.05 in at least 50% of logs.

hypotheses.anchor: Balle-Wang analytic Gaussian (sigma 3.7/2.0/1.08 at eps 1/2/4 for L2 sensitivity 1); Desfontaines et al. / Korolova: thresholds need about 12 users at eps=1; amplification by subsampling not applied here (conservative)
hypotheses.analysis: Per log and n in {1000,3000,10000}: NDCG@100 steady mean of each gauss arm minus the non-private baseline (same people). Table of loss by (eps,c,n) with share of logs with loss < 0.05; smallest n on the grid with loss < 0.05 per eps. Noise is added to every item of the catalogue (known domain), delta=1e-5.

hypotheses.title_zh: 本地差分隐私的代价表
hypotheses.statement_en: Local differential privacy (optimised unary encoding, one row per person) at n=10000 loses more than 0.1 NDCG even at eps=4.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 本地差分隐私（优化的一元编码，每人一条）在 n=10000 时即使 eps=4 也损失超过 0.1 NDCG。

prediction.text: At n=10000, eps=4 loses > 0.1 in at least 50% of eligible logs.

hypotheses.anchor: Wang et al. 2017: Var = 4 n e^eps/(e^eps-1)^2 per count (std 0.19 of share at eps=1, n=100 per LitPrivacy); local DP needs about 50-100x more people in our main study (X9)
hypotheses.analysis: Same layout as D16 for the oue arms. Report loss by (eps,n) and the share of logs with loss > 0.1 at n=10000, eps=4.

hypotheses.title_en: How long a list can be published
hypotheses.title_zh: 在计数阈值下能发布多长的榜单
hypotheses.statement_en: With a minimum running count of 5 reports per published item, a server with 100 people per round can publish fewer than 50 items.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 每个发布的物品要求累计至少 5 次汇报时，每轮 100 人的服务器只能发布不足 50 个物品。

prediction.text: At n=100, t=5: median list length (len100 metric) < 50 and precision of the published items (prec100) >= 0.5.

hypotheses.anchor: LitPrivacy: deployed thresholds 10-50 users (Chrome k=10-50, TrieHH theta=10-17); publishable items <= n*c/tau
hypotheses.analysis: From the len100 and prec100 metrics of athr arms vs n in {10,30,100,300,1000,3000}: table of median published length and precision by (t,n); the smallest n for which t=5 publishes a full 100 items.

hypotheses.title_zh: 等效年龄（重复检验）
hypotheses.statement_en: A list from 100 people per round is worth a full count that is 3 to 6 rounds old, on the new categories and the new non-Amazon logs too.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 每轮 100 人的榜单，相当于一份 3 到 6 轮前的全量统计，在新类别和新的非 Amazon 日志上同样如此。

prediction.text: Median equivalent age at n=100 over fresh and new logs lies in [3, 6] rounds.

hypotheses.anchor: Tracking study (equivalent age 1.3-8, median 4.4 on Amazon)
hypotheses.analysis: For each log and n: equivalent age = the lag L (linear interpolation between grid lags 0,1,2,3,4,6,8) at which NDCG of full:lag=L equals NDCG of the baseline tracker; censored at 8 if baseline is below lag 8 and 0 if above lag 0. Report by n in {30,100,300,1000} and by stratum (Amazon discovery / Amazon holdout and fresh / non-Amazon).

hypotheses.title_zh: 最佳半衰期随榜单长度的变化
hypotheses.statement_en: The best half-life is shorter for a top-10 list than for a top-300 list.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 前 10 名榜单的最佳半衰期短于前 300 名榜单。

prediction.text: In at least 60% of logs the best half-life for k=10 is <= the best half-life for k=300 (ties count as met), and strictly shorter in at least 25%.

hypotheses.anchor: [INFERENCE] head items turn over faster than the tail
hypotheses.analysis: Using nd10, nd30, nd100(from nd100 array), nd300 steady means of the seven decay arms at n=100: best half-life per k and log; share of logs with best(k=10) <= best(k=300), share strictly shorter; table of mean NDCG by (k,h).

hypotheses.title_en: People needed for 95% of the ceiling
hypotheses.title_zh: 达到上限 95% 所需的人数
hypotheses.statement_en: Even 3000 people per round do not reach 95% of what a full count of all rounds with the same half-life achieves, in most logs.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 即使每轮 3000 人，也达不到用同样半衰期的全量统计所能达到的 95%，在多数日志里如此。

prediction.text: For k=100, NDCG(baseline, n=3000) < 0.95 x NDCG(fulldecay h=2) in at least 70% of logs eligible at n=3000.

hypotheses.anchor: Dyer-Owen style bounds / main study: drift not sampling dominates; equivalent age 4.4 at n=100
hypotheses.analysis: Ratio NDCG(baseline,n)/NDCG(fulldecay h=2) by n; for each log the smallest n with ratio >= 0.95 (censored if never) for k=100 and, from nd10/nd30/nd300 where available, k in {10,30,300}. Report share of logs that reach 95% by n, and the fitted slope of (1-ratio) against log n.

hypotheses.title_zh: 冷启动需要几轮
hypotheses.statement_en: With half-life 2 the list reaches 90% of its steady-state NDCG within 3 rounds at n=100 (a new tracker is useful after 3 rounds).
hypotheses.statement_zh: 半衰期为 2 时，榜单在 3 轮内达到稳态 NDCG 的 90%（新追踪器 3 轮后就有用）。

prediction.text: Median round at which mean NDCG (over draws) first reaches 90% of the steady mean is <= 3 for h=2 and >= 4 for h=inf, at n=100.

hypotheses.anchor: Exponential smoothing: effective memory 1/(1-2^(-1/h)) = 3.4 rounds at h=2
hypotheses.analysis: From the per-step nd100 arrays (steps start at round 2): steady mean = mean over steps >= 8; first step index (round number = step) at which the draw-mean reaches 0.9 x steady; by half-life and n in {30,100,300}.

hypotheses.title_zh: 糟糕的轮次有多糟
hypotheses.statement_en: At n=300 the 10th-percentile round is within 0.10 NDCG of the mean round; at n=30 it is more than 0.15 below.
hypotheses.statement_zh: n=300 时，第 10 百分位的那一轮与平均轮相差不超过 0.10；n=30 时相差超过 0.15。

prediction.text: Median over logs of (mean - 10th percentile of per-round NDCG over steps >= 8 and draws): <= 0.10 at n=300 and >= 0.15 at n=30.

hypotheses.anchor: [INFERENCE] sampling noise shrinks as 1/sqrt(n); round-to-round shifts are part of drift
hypotheses.analysis: From per-step nd100 arrays pooled over draws and steps >= 8: mean, p10, p5 and the gap by n; median over logs by n and stratum.

hypotheses.title_en: Does the server's own score track true quality
hypotheses.title_zh: 服务器自己的评分能反映真实质量吗
hypotheses.statement_en: NDCG of the published list against the next round's own sample (no ground truth needed) is rank-correlated with the true NDCG at 0.7 or more across logs, round lengths and n.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 已发布榜单对下一轮自身样本的 NDCG（不需要真值）与真实 NDCG 的秩相关在各日志、轮长、n 之间不低于 0.7。

prediction.text: Spearman correlation across (log, n_win, n) cells between steady mean selfnd and steady mean nd100 of the baseline is >= 0.7 (pooled over stages cal and plan; also reported within each n).

hypotheses.anchor: LitMonitoring: the next-round sample gives an unbiased unnormalised DCG (prequential scheme, Gama et al. 2013); the sample-ideal normaliser is biased upward
hypotheses.analysis: Cells from stages cal and plan (baseline arm only). x = mean of selfnd over steps >= 8 and draws, y = mean nd100. Spearman pooled; within each n; within each n_win; also Spearman between the cell-level ratio selfnd/nd100 and n (bias check).

hypotheses.title_en: Does list churn say how stale the list is
hypotheses.title_zh: 榜单变动幅度能说明榜单有多旧吗
hypotheses.statement_en: The churn of the published list between rounds is rank-correlated at 0.5 or more with how far the list is behind a full count (NDCG(fulldecay h=2) minus NDCG(baseline)).
hypotheses.statement_zh: 榜单在相邻两轮之间的变动幅度，与它落后于全量统计的程度（全量衰减榜单 NDCG 减基线 NDCG）的秩相关不低于 0.5。

prediction.text: Not met expected: |Spearman| < 0.5 across (log, n_win) cells at n=100 (literature: churn measures noise and inertia, not staleness).

hypotheses.anchor: Webber et al. 2010 (RBO between successive lists); Garg et al. 2022 (accuracy without labels is as hard as learning); decayed sums mechanically lower churn at longer half-lives
hypotheses.analysis: Cells from stage cal at n=100 (all n_win): x = mean churn of baseline (steady), y = mean nd100 of fulldecay:h=2 minus baseline. Spearman pooled and by n_win; also against best-days stability.

hypotheses.title_en: Split-half agreement as a quality meter
hypotheses.title_zh: 半样本一致度作为质量指标
hypotheses.statement_en: The overlap between top-100 lists built from two random halves of the reporters is rank-correlated at 0.7 or more with the true NDCG, for n of 300 or more.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 由随机两半汇报者各自建出的前 100 名榜单的重合度，与真实 NDCG 的秩相关不低于 0.7（n 不小于 300 时）。

prediction.text: Spearman(agree, nd100) across (log, n) cells with n >= 300 is >= 0.7; at n=30 it is below 0.5.

hypotheses.anchor: LitMonitoring: split-half is the noise floor; Mogstad et al. 2022 rank confidence sets; informative only when n >= about 400
hypotheses.analysis: From stage plan, arm half:h=2: agree metric (steady mean) and nd100 of the same arm; Spearman pooled over (log, n) for n >= 300, and for n = 30, 100 separately.

hypotheses.title_en: How flat is the best half-life in days
hypotheses.title_zh: 最佳半衰期（按天）有多平坦
hypotheses.statement_en: On Amazon logs any half-life from 300 to 700 days is within 0.01 NDCG of the best of the days grid, for rounds of 3 to 9 months.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 在 Amazon 日志上，对于每轮 3 到 9 个月的情形，300 到 700 天之间的任意半衰期都与天数网格中的最佳值相差不超过 0.01 NDCG。

prediction.text: For at least 80% of Amazon (log, n_win in {30,45,60,90}) cells the NDCG regret of each of 300, 400, 534, 700 days is <= 0.01 relative to the best of the eight days values.

hypotheses.anchor: Our tournament rounds 3 (400 days +0.057, 534 days +0.054, 700 days +0.031 at 90 rounds on holdout)
hypotheses.analysis: Per Amazon log and n_win: NDCG (steady mean) by days; regret to best; share of cells where regret <= 0.01 for each days value; best days distribution by n_win; figure of mean regret against days.

hypotheses.title_en: Is the calendar half-life stable on non-Amazon logs
hypotheses.title_zh: 非 Amazon 日志上日历半衰期稳定吗
hypotheses.statement_en: On each non-Amazon log the best half-life in days stays within a factor of 2 across 45, 60 and 90 rounds.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 在每个非 Amazon 日志上，最佳半衰期（按天）在 45、60、90 轮之间变化不超过 2 倍。

prediction.text: At least 60% of eligible non-Amazon logs have max/min best days <= 2 across n_win 45, 60, 90 (best over the combined days and rounds grid, using decay:days arms only for the days axis).

hypotheses.anchor: Earlier calendar check (11 of 18 logs same in days; Amazon 494-587; Gowalla 83); [INFERENCE] growing platforms prefer shorter spans
hypotheses.analysis: Per non-Amazon log: best days among the eight decay:days arms at each n_win in {45,60,90} (n=100); ratio max/min; also list the best days per log and width; stratify new logs vs old.

hypotheses.title_en: Self-tuning half-life on other kinds of logs
hypotheses.title_zh: 其他类型日志上的自调半衰期
hypotheses.statement_en: On non-Amazon logs a server that picks its half-life from its own samples recovers at least half of the gain of the best fixed half-life over half-life 2 in 60% of cases and is never worse than 0.01; on Amazon logs it is worse than 0.01 in at least 30% of cases.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 在非 Amazon 日志上，用自己样本选半衰期的服务器，在 60% 的情形里追回最佳固定半衰期相对半衰期 2 的至少一半收益，且从不差于 0.01；在 Amazon 日志上则有至少 30% 的情形差于 0.01。

prediction.text: Non-Amazon (log, n_win) cells at n=100: share with (selfsel - base) >= 0.5 x (best fixed - base) is >= 0.6 among cells where best fixed - base >= 0.01, and no cell has selfsel - base < -0.01; Amazon cells: share with selfsel - base < -0.01 is >= 0.3.

hypotheses.anchor: Tracking study PD (Other stratum 9 of 12 cells recovered half, 0 harmful; Amazon harmful in 51% of 59 cells)
hypotheses.analysis: From stage cal arms: per cell selfsel vs baseline and vs the best of the seven half-life arms. Report the stratified shares above, by n_win, and the chosen half-life index distribution (chosen_h_idx).

hypotheses.title_en: Do conclusions depend on the metric
hypotheses.title_zh: 结论是否依赖评价指标
hypotheses.statement_en: The ordering of the 30-odd aggregation arms by mean difference is the same under recall@100, NDCG@10, NDCG@30 and NDCG@300 as under NDCG@100 (rank correlation 0.9 or more), and no gain or loss verdict flips sign.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 三十多个聚合方式按平均差排序，在 recall@100、NDCG@10、NDCG@30、NDCG@300 下与 NDCG@100 下一致（秩相关不低于 0.9），且没有任何增益或损失的结论反号。

prediction.text: Spearman between the vector of mean diffs (arm minus baseline, n=100, all logs) under NDCG@100 and under each other metric is >= 0.9; number of arms whose sign flips with |diff| > 0.005 under NDCG@100 is 0.

hypotheses.anchor: LitMonitoring: NDCG@k vs recall@k vs RBO agree on large effects, can disagree on small ones
hypotheses.analysis: From stage agg metrics (nd10, nd30, nd300, rec100) and nd100: per arm mean diff vs baseline at n=100 over logs; Spearman across arms; sign flips.

protocol.paired: Primary combination: n=100, 30 rounds, nd100 steady-state (steps >= 8) mean over draws, one diff per log (arm minus ref). Discovery = logs of groups discovery + new_discovery; holdout = holdout_old + holdout_fresh + new_holdout. Per hypothesis one-sided t p-value on the discovery logs; Benjamini-Hochberg at q=0.10 across all paired hypotheses whose prediction claims a gain, a loss bound or a difference; a hypothesis is CONFIRMED only if it passes BH on discovery with mean diff >= margin (superiority) AND on the holdout logs the diff has the same sign, mean >= margin and one-sided p < 0.05 / (number of hypotheses selected). Non-inferiority (D08): lower one-sided t bound of the diff > -0.005 and churn cut >= 30% on discovery and holdout. Every verdict also gets a plain label from the 95% t interval of the mean diff over all logs: GAIN (lower bound > +margin/2 ... see analysis), LOSS, NO DIFFERENCE (interval inside +/- margin), INCONCLUSIVE.
protocol.calc: Each calculator hypothesis states a numeric prediction; the verdict is MET or NOT MET on the stated numbers plus the full table. No multiplicity adjustment: these are measurements with pre-set thresholds.
protocol.eligibility: A (log, n, n_win) cell is run only if at least 10 steps have all of rounds w-7..w+1 with >= 5n active people (same rule as before).
protocol.seasons: seas arms are only run at round lengths of at most 182 days (lag of at least 2 rounds).
